'''Mokan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. At some point he became part of the [[Order of Revan]] and joined with the Revanite forces on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. During the [[Battle of Rishi]] in [[3637 BBY]] he was attacked by a strike team that tried to reach the signal jammer on the [[Razorback Island]] and was killed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Commander Mokan appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].
